# India

Region: Asia. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### Reserve Bank of India

**Role:** RTGS/NEFT operator and regulator

**Reporting coverage:** NG-RTGS ISO 20022 adoption; CAMT052/053 coverage not established

**Messages / versions:** ISO20022 RTGS; exact families not verified

- [RBI centralised payment-system accessFAQ](https://systemhealth.rbi.org.in/Scripts/FS_FAQs.aspx_Id%3D144%26fn%3D9.html) — availability; public-page
- [RBI payment-system vision](https://systemhealth.rbi.org.in/Scripts/PublicationVisionDocuments.aspx_Id%3D1202.html) — availability; public-page

The RBI FAQ states that NG-RTGS is built on ISO 20022 with liquidity and future-date features. The payments vision discusses migration of RBI-operated messages. An exact public CAMT052/053 implementation guide was not confirmed; RTGS adoption alone does not establish statement availability.
